text:
The sun rises in the east.

The original sentence contains a dangling modifier. "Flying over the tropical island" modifies "the view," but a view cannot fly. To fix this, the subject of the main clause must be the one performing the action of flying.

Here is the corrected sentence:

Flying over the tropical island, the passengers saw a breathtaking view from the airplane.

Alternatively, you can rephrase it to keep the focus on the view:

From the airplane, the view of the tropical island was breathtaking.
